hard_gates.gate: G1 tenant isolation (HTTP shares, company, noninterference, list volume, client state, browser client isolation)
hard_gates.evidence: Run 2 passed every dotnet group (1198/1198), including http-0..3, http-judge, ni-0..2, ni-judge, listvolume, self-*, gates-rest and projects. Web clientIsolation and e2e client-isolation also passed. Run 1 failed G1HttpIsolationShardTests share 4 and G1HttpIsolationTests (judge) on one finding: tenant A's GET /api/identity/roles?filter=nameEn contains '116772' and GET /api/audit/log?filter=record contains '116772' returned tenant A's own role 'attack-116772' and its audit entry. The gate itself wrote that role: G1HttpIsolationTests.cs:1423 names written strings attack-{n} from a running counter, and n reached 116772, which is also one of tenant B's values. That makes it a gate false positive, not a leak (routed to p00). My own attack on the demo found no leak. Tenant B (admin@gulfsteel.example) got 404 for each of tenant A's contacts by id and for A's user by id. B's list filters, including the home trend filters on createdAt, returned only B's 1006 contacts. Filters on id, tenantId and 'or 1 eq 1' were refused with 400. noaccess@alnoor got 403 on contacts and users. As erp_app with no tenant set, contacts.contacts showed 0 rows, and RLS is enabled and forced on the contacts and identity tables. p18 adds no endpoint, table, job or file path. Its client surfaces are the per-user key erp.nav.<user id> (in client-carriers.txt, removed by the forgetter at sign-out), the identity-scoped toasts, the home cards and the device keys erp.theme and erp.density.

It was caught by G1ClientStateTests.Every_piece_of_module_level_state_in_the_web_sources_is_reviewed ('web/src/kernel/ui.tsx:55 const store = new Map...'), run through verify-slot (plants/P1-run.log). gates-rest and every http group passed in run 2. Plant P2b removed the permission from the identity home card (the r1 gate gap, backlog row 22). The real product keeps that guard, and the server still refuses the actions.

biggest_gap.title: The clean-clone verify fails on p18's own page change during import-5000, and list names and e-mails are still cut with no way to read them
biggest_gap.detail: Blocking fault: in both full verifies from a fresh clone, the built-ours comparison health check judged import-5000 invalid. The contacts page changes what it shows with no counted step causing it: a style recalculation of no traceable origin 0.2 s into the measured part, while the list renders under the Import click. This is the same failure that kept r2 from being integrated. The last p18 commits (overflow titles written in a layout effect) did not remove it, so the one command (G3) still does not pass. A builder should make the title marking write nothing at all while a render triggered by a fetch or scheduler is committing (or find the other p18 writer), and then get several health runs of import-5000 on the verify stack to pass, not only on a demo. Design gap that also loses the checklist to Odoo: names and e-mails in the contacts list (and codes in the Arabic companies, branches and numbering lists) end in an ellipsis with no title on hover or focus. The ellipsis sits on an inner <span> (inline-block, overflow hidden), and neither the overflowTitles candidates nor the design.spec.ts check look inside the cell. The same 100,000-contact list in Odoo cuts nothing.

other_findings: The kernel DateInput (web/src/kernel/forms/dateInput.tsx, p18's) still breaks a date typed the way its own dd/mm/yyyy placeholder shows. Typing '15/06/2027' gives '15//06/202', because the auto-slash is added and then the typed slash too, and maxLength cuts the year. '2027-06-15' gives '20/27/-06-'. Ctrl+S then refuses with 'Enter a date as year-month-day (2026-12-31), from 1900 to 2200.', which contradicts the placeholder. Only the bare digits '15062027' save. This was routed to p18 by the p09 critic and is still open. Repro: open any contact, Custom fields, Credit review date (scripts/s6.mjs, screenshot 07).

Theme and density are still kept per device, not per user as the spec says ('chosen per user and remembered', 'kept per user'). After admin.ar chose Light and Comfortable and signed out, viewer@alnoor on the same browser got light/comfortable. admin.ar on a fresh browser got the default dark/compact (scripts/s7.mjs). The home dashboard is still not useful at real volume: '108,016 things need you today', because 100,004 users who never signed in count as attention. The Contacts card (100,005, active only) differs from the list header (100,006). No sparkline appears: the seeded contacts are dated 2023, so all 12 trend points are 0 and the chart is hidden. [route: p00-foundation] G1HttpIsolationTests writes strings as attack-{n} from a running counter (G1HttpIsolationTests.cs:1423). In run 1, n reached 116772, which is also one of tenant B's values. So tenant A's own role 'attack-116772' and its audit entry answered A's later filter 'nameEn contains 116772' / 'record contains 116772', and both the share-4 test and the judge failed as a false positive (verify1-failed-reports/dotnet-http-3.log, dotnet-http-judge.log). Written values must never collide with victim markers, for example by using a prefix or range the victim values cannot hold.

[route: p00-foundation] An intermittent server error on the demo: 'System.Exception: Received unexpected backend message DataRow. Please file a bug.' in Erp.Kernel.Data.ErpDbSession.BeginAsync (ErpDbSession.cs:194, with prefetch), from SessionResolver.ResolveAsync. It happened right after two sign-ins of the same user, and ErpExceptionHandler then threw ObjectDisposedException NpgsqlTransaction. Two concurrent requests failed at 11:52:39Z and two at 11:57:31Z, and the second time the contacts screen showed 'The list could not be loaded: HTTP 500' during the attach-file comparison. I could not reproduce it with 20 sign-in-then-leave rounds or with 12 rounds of two sessions firing 16 concurrent requests. It looks like a pooled connection whose protocol stream got out of step.
[route: p01-odoo-rig] The harness's keyboard-navigation task still reports ours not_built ('waits for p04 with p16'), so the task is never compared.

Fixed since r1, and must stay fixed: column resizing (10 handles); section tabs reachable by keyboard (tabIndex 0) and no longer cut; navigation icons with collapsible groups and P to pin; command-bar icons on most buttons; palette '>' commands and Tab mode; toasts ('Saved.'); search drop-down for long lists and look-ups; attachments Delete buttons not cut; credit limit shows AED; the identity home card's permission guard is now covered by a test (r1 gate gap).
